what: integrate-vfs deletes crates/vfs last. I swapped every other vfs import in blaze-engine to base_db:: (same types; FileId, VfsPath, FileSet, AbsPathBuf). What's left is v1 `vfs::Vfs`, the path<->FileId table, which is a restructure, so it's yours: lib.rs:102 `use vfs::Vfs` and its uses (load at ~1873/1888 `vfs::Vfs::default()`, the &mut vfs params at ~2065/2166/2287, 4326/4337 `vfs.file_path`, write_inputs 4387, the test at ~11392), check.rs:19, doc.rs:323/367/381/424, mirdump.rs:98, borrowck.rs:167 (+ consteval.rs:63 and borrowck.rs:84 `vfs.file_id(&VfsPath::from(..))`). v2: base-db is the path table. Files come in through `Db::set_view_root` (a blaze-vfs view's files; base-db assigns FileIds and source roots), path->file is `Db::file_for_path(&VfsPath)` and file->path is `Db::path_for_file(FileId)` (queue 00970 to db adds both; integrate-vfs adds them itself if db doesn't take it in two check passes), new IDs `Db::new_file_id`. Then drop `vfs.workspace = true` from crates/blaze-engine/Cargo.toml. Tell integrate-vfs (done note) when nothing in blaze-engine names `vfs`.

history.note: blaze-engine no longer names vfs: its lib is now the `blaze` program (program.rs, pin.rs, versions.rs); every v1 module using vfs::Vfs (lib.rs tail, check.rs, doc.rs, mirdump.rs, borrowck.rs, consteval.rs) is git rm'd and `vfs` is gone from crates/blaze-engine/Cargo.toml and its Cargo.lock dependency list. (as_rustc.rs stays as a file no mod names, being ported by integrate-engine-rustc; it names no vfs.)
